title.zh: Europe’s top regulator questions Polymarket and Kalshi’s EU access, warns of authorization gaps

current_state.zh: Europe's top securities regulator is scrutinizing Polymarket and Kalshi's EU operations, warning that the prediction-market platforms may lack the required authorization to serve European users.
